description: A retro-style television with a vibrant yellow casing and a rounded screen. The screen displays a gradient of purple and green, suggesting it's either on or stylized for visual appeal. It features two extendable antennas, a prominent silver dome on top, and control knobs and indicator lights on the right side. The overall design evokes a sense of nostalgia and mid-20th century technology, with a slightly whimsical and modern interpretation.
